# PUMA Analyzer

> PUMA Analyzer is a Windows desktop application that estimates thin-film thickness and optical constants (refractive index n, extinction coefficient k) from a measured transmission spectrum, using a physics-based transmittance model and a compiled C nonlinear-optimization engine.

The core engine implements the unconstrained-optimization thin-film
parameter estimation method of Birgin, Chambouleyron and Martinez,
minimizing the sum of squared residuals between a measured and modeled
transmittance spectrum: T(lambda) = A*x / (B - C*x*cos(phi) + D*x^2),
with x = exp(-4*pi*k*d/lambda) and phi = 4*pi*n*d/lambda. From the fitted
n, k, and thickness d it derives dozens of further quantities: optical
band gap (Tauc, direct and indirect), Urbach energy, Wemple-DiDomenico
dispersion, dielectric function, and a Kramers-Kronig consistency check,
among others.

PUMA Analyzer is proprietary software, Copyright Amin Al-Zu'bi, gated by
a one-time activation code (not a subscription). It is not open source;
this repository holds only release binaries, documentation, sample data,
and the app's update-check manifest, no application source code.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/blob/main/README.md): full project description, the physics equations behind every derived quantity, real screenshots and a workflow animation, and a step-by-step guide to reproducing a result with the included sample dataset.
- [How the core engine works](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/blob/main/README.md#how-the-core-engine-works): the transmittance model and fitting algorithm, with equations.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/blob/main/README.md#faq): activation, privacy, and troubleshooting questions.
- [Version history](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/blob/main/README.md#version-history): one highlight per release from 3.0 to the current version.

## Releases

- [Latest release](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/releases/latest): current Windows build (.zip), no separate install needed.
- [All releases](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/releases): every past version with its own release notes.
- [version.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/main/version.json): the machine-readable manifest the app's own update checker reads.

## Sample data

- [sigl0097t-dat.txt](https://github.com/ameenalzubi0-bit/puma-analyzer-releases/blob/main/samples/sigl0097t-dat.txt): a real measured transmission spectrum, the same one used in the README's worked example.
